payload.title: Make initial SQLite Conversation schema installation atomic
payload.summary: P2: _ensure_schema wraps executescript in a connection context but the DDL script has no explicit transaction. A deterministic SQLite authorizer denial on the second CREATE TABLE occurs after sessions is durably installed at user_version0. The connection closes; ordinary save retry refuses this self-created nonempty v0 database as PersistenceFormatError. No data was deleted and fail-closed refusal after partial state is appropriate; partial installation is the defect. Baseline 206d58e271014e08cda8d18774b5fc86f406bf84. Acceptance: Install fresh schema tables, indexes and user_version together or roll back to the original empty state on a controlled intermediate failure. Test failures during tables/index/version setup, connection closure, clean retry and successful save/load. Preserve byte/data custody and refusal for unrelated nonempty databases or preexisting unknown partial schemas; do not auto-delete/reinitialize them. Keep supported v1 schema unchanged and avoid a migration/recovery framework.
payload.benefit: Repair the existing Conversation storage contract in its current owner without a new backend, ORM, transaction framework or Evidence store.
payload.uncertainty: Temporary authored databases, deterministic SQLite callbacks/threads and subprocess exits. No user data, live models, power-loss claim or actual autonomous-agent damage. No maintained native store caller beyond tests found.
dependencies: Separate maintainer-authorized bounded implementation with permanent independent regressions and full unchanged protected gate.
B-0027/B-0028 retain broader representation, retention and consumer decisions. Three same-owner findings are independently testable siblings, not automatic duplicates.
